verdict.rationale: Mercury's Books page explicitly says you can "Link external bank accounts, cards, payroll platforms, and more." The launch post says transactions across banking and cards are pulled in automatically and reconciled in real time. That covers the core of the story, but the evidence is entirely vendor marketing and gives no detail on how external connections sync. missing for 10: documented sync cadence or mechanism for external (non-Mercury) bank and card feeds, setup docs naming supported institutions or the connection provider, and independent or hands-on corroboration that external transactions import automatically.
